title: The Narrow Letter
verdict: Bianca Hart was responsible for the disappearance of a notebook of sourdough formulas.
intent: Bianca Hart wanted to steal a winning recipe for a rival shop.
The culprit needed delayed discovery so the object could pass the first search and be recovered later.
action_schema: Use role-specific access: the night baker had been alone near the office after the final recipe check.
Remove a notebook of sourdough formulas from its checked location.
Hide the item in a flour bin with a false bottom.
Allow incomplete suspicion to fall on distractor suspects.
evidence_cues: a notebook of sourdough formulas disappeared from a bakery kitchen before a regional baking contest.
The object was confirmed present before the relevant disturbance.
The disappearance occurred within a narrow time window because the mixer timer was set to mask the office door chime.
The physical trace was rye flour on the office doorknob.
The relevant tool or mechanism was a dough scraper dusted with rye flour.
The item could be concealed in a flour bin with a false bottom.
The hiding place required insider knowledge because only the night baker used the rye-flour bin that morning and knew about its loose false bottom.
distractor_cues: a quarrel about contest prize money
a delivery driver arriving late with large crates
A visible conflict is suspicious but insufficient without timing and mechanism.
A bulky object or nervous behavior is insufficient unless it explains the hidden container.
